title: Describe each tile: keep people words out, fix the hover text, price a paid naming run
description: From MPI-1232. (1) The hover on Describe each tile says 'People and faces are never described' (PromptBoxControls.js tileDescribe info). Not fully true: the describer is TOLD to ignore people, but live 2026-10-23 at tile 1024 it named 'curly gray hair and beard' and 'a man's shoulder and neck' on tiles a person only partly covers. The person stays protected (the mask keeps people out of the tile), but the words reach that tile's background. Fix: drop a name with people words in cleanTileName (js/services/tileDescribe.js, like the rectangle/outline guard), then make the hover text true. (2) A paid endpoint describer names every tile with no price shown first (150 tiles on a 4000x6000 at 2x). No per-call price is known up front; pick: log the total after naming, show it only past a few cents. Fabio's call on the threshold.
